question: Google Research 의 Harness²(recursive agent harnessing)는 왜 모델 가중치를 고정한 채 에이전트 성능을 끌어올릴 수 있는가? 흔히 이야기되는 다른 하네스 개선 기법들과 비교해 무엇이 더 나으며, 그중 실제로 실증된 것은 무엇이고 주장에 그치는 것은 무엇인가?
mode: fix run on PR #26, non-interactive. The owner decided the three open items in the request; the researcher ships with ship.mjs.
stoppedBecause: fix round: no must-fix from lens B, lens A items applied, recheck found no hard item

check-claims.tail:
--repo google-research/harness2=<path> 로 알려주거나, RESEARCH_CHECKOUT_DIR 를 설정하거나,
    git clone --filter=blob:none https://github.com/google-research/harness2.git

FAIL  research/2026-10-25-harness2-recursive-agent-harnessing  (주장 73개, 근거 115개, 출처 2개)
      [quote-match] 체크아웃 없이 검증된 주장이 있다 (google-research/harness2)
      논문 근거 100건 중 47건은 표·그림으로 좁히지 못해 문서 전체에서 대조했다

1건이 막혔다. 고치거나 --allow= 로 명시적으로 넘길 것.

rendered_note: headless Chrome via scripts/render.mjs after the last fix; w1280 cover, w390 cover and w1280 ch04 were opened and read
decided: kind = explainer. The request leads with 왜 (mechanism) and asks to sort demonstrated from claimed. It asks for no adopt/hold call, so the comparison with other techniques is one chapter (7) plus the margin chapter (9).
corpus = arXiv 2610.14224 v1 (LaTeX e-print, sha256 pinned) as primary, google-research/harness2 at commit 1cfe254 as secondary. Both exist; nothing was invented.

'other harness improvement techniques' = the baselines the paper actually ran (Best-of-k, ReasoningBank, Harness Scaling, Meta-Harness) plus the paper's own positioning table. Methods only listed in that table were not read.
The verdict scale (실증 / 부분 실증 / 주장) is this document's own, stated as such in chapter 12. A margin counts as clear only when it exceeds the standard deviation on both sides.
Values from charts without printed numbers (total_cost, scaling_curves) are shown as approximations read off coordinates and marked so. PNG-only figure values are claims with verdict unverified.

Code claims (the selector pool excludes base executions, the leak guard is a 7-marker tripwire, the 4k/3k schedule) come from reading the code. The code was not executed, because there were no model credentials.

Owner decision (1), applied: the cover flow last column now holds two cards, one linked to chapter 9 (기법 대비) and one to chapter 11 (배우는 개선). Chapters 9 and 11 left the toc list; chapter 12 (판정), which the old last card pointed at, moved into the toc list so it stays reachable from the cover.
The last flow column is labelled 근거가 얇다, not 주장. Lens A noted that chapter 12 rates the technique comparison 부분 실증 and only the learning claim 주장에 가깝다, so one 주장 label would equate them.
The toc line for chapter 12 names the two weak verdicts that are off the flow (누출 방지 주장, 부품 기여 부분 실증), as lens A suggested.
Owner decision (2): chapter 13 unchanged. Owner decision (3): no chapter mapping failure types to edited components.

Owner decision (4), applied: the chapter 4 note drops 비싼 모델 and reads 공개 코드의 일정대로라면 과제 하나에 편집 모델(Opus 4.8)이 3k 번 불린다. The condition 공개 코드의 일정대로라면 stays because the 3k schedule comes from the code and the paper does not state its runs used the same schedule (claim c74 scope).
unverified: c14, c15, c45: token positions read off Figure total_cost coordinates (approximate; lens B re-read the rendered PDF and matched).
c23, c57: same_model PNG values (Opus 5 JobBench is the largest; Gemini 3.5 Flash JobBench +0.9).
c53: library_transfer values that the gate cannot scope (wrapfigure); lens B matched them against the PDF.
Absence claims: 3 (c5, c62, c66), each with a re-runnable search.
Code behaviour claims were read, not executed: k=1 trivial selection, selection pool, 4k/3k schedule, library admission.
No independent replication found. A web search on 2026-10-25 returned only restatements (hyper.ai, the-agent-report.com, themenonlab.blog, techjacksolutions.com).

unfixed.item: Ch04 last note: 3k counts propose and compose sessions only; the previous note says selection and reflection sessions come on top. A reader could take 3k as all editor calls (recheck, wording).
Cover answer names two weak claims; the toc line for chapter 12 also names 누출 방지 and 부품 기여. Emphasis differs, nothing is wrong (recheck, wording).
Cover answer says 12개 조건 모두에서 측정됐다 without chapter 12s caveat that two JobBench Codex conditions are within noise; chapter 8 carries it (recheck, wording).

commitSubject: Harness² 문서의 표지 흐름을 9장과 11장으로 잇고 4장 메모를 원문대로 고치다
commitBody:
소유자의 결정대로 PR #26 의 Harness² 문서(research/2026-10-25-harness2-recursive-agent-harnessing)를 고친다. 표지 흐름의 마지막 열을 9장(기법 대비)과 11장(배우는 개선) 두 상자로 나누고, 12장(판정)을 목록으로 옮겼다. 4장 메모의 "비싼 모델" 은 논문에 가격 비교가 없어 빼고, 편집 모델(Opus 4.8)이 공개 코드 일정대로 3k 번 불린다고 썼다. 13장은 그대로 두고 새 장은 만들지 않았다.

출처:
- arXiv 2610.14224 v1, Harness²: Recursive Agent Harnessing for an Open World (LaTeX e-print, text sha256 d97ff280)
- google-research/harness2 커밋 1cfe254e8d25b15f37048c3730134686abe60335
